summary: Indexed lookup over a two-entry set of module globals. For a1 == 0 returns dword_5BF8CC, for a1 == 1 returns dword_5BF8D4, and for any a1 > 1 returns -1. The parameter is an unsigned small index that selects between two adjacent global dwords.

operations.description: Initialize the default result to -1 before the range check.
Guard on a1 <= 1; only indices 0 and 1 reach the lookup, everything larger falls through to the -1 default.
Nested guard on a1 being non-zero; separates the a1 == 1 path from the a1 == 0 path.
Return the default -1 for any a1 > 1.
